metadata.title: Tribes of North East must unite - Sangma | त्रिपुरा में गूंजा आदिवासी एकता का नारा - संगमा
metadata.description: Meghalaya Chief Minister Conrad Sangma appealed to all tribal communities of North East India to fight in unity to preserve their cultural, economic and ethnic identity. Sangma  who was the Chief Guest at Tipra Motha rally also extended his support to the Motha's charter of demands including Tipraland.
